abstract: Pearson plc announced the complete retirement of its Smarthinking human tutoring service, replacing it entirely with AI-powered chatbot tutors. This represents a significant instance of workforce displacement in the education sector, where a major educational company has fully transitioned from human tutors to artificial intelligence-based alternatives.
keyFindings: Pearson fully retired its Smarthinking human tutoring service
The service was replaced entirely with AI-powered chatbot tutors
This represents complete displacement of a human tutoring workforce by AI at a major education company
methodology: Not specified. Source is a company announcement rather than a research study.
